scope: read-only QA review of U4a model dumps: dump identity (bytes/sha), independent dumper rerun for determinism (twice per file, same path), dump semantics vs dump-counts.json, tool identity, scope (no src/fixtures/Cargo/scripts/*.rs), intermediate .mjb not committed, evidence manifest; no GPU, no device execution, no product code change

method.recompute: recompute.py (8 checks -> recompute.json; committed blobs via git cat-file; dumps parsed with pinned python)
method.determinism_rerun: target/render-bvh/s0a/compile_scene_312.exe (MuJoCo 3.12.0) run twice per file with the verbatim evidence commands and PATH += target/toolchains/mujoco-3.12.0/package/bin; recorded in materials/rerun-determinism.txt

semantics.sdf_leaf_rule_premise: geom_size 0.35 and mesh bounds +/-0.35 coexist, so U4 host cases can assert mesh-bounds usage

observations.text: determinism independently reproduced: 4 dump runs (twice per file, same output path) all exit 0 and all sha equal committed; rerun only wrote target/*.mjb and byte-identical JSON, repo tree unchanged

the dump's tool field only carries the name compile_scene_312, while the tool sha256 lives only in the evidence material/receipt; if the dumper is ever rebuilt the dump cannot prove its tool identity - optional future improvement (would change dump sha and require refreshing material)
the ~9.4 MB .mjb intermediate exists only under target/render-bvh/sdf-model-dump (untracked); that dir also holds a working-copy determinism.txt which does not affect the repo

determinism requires the identical output path because the dump embeds model_file; the evidence determinism.txt states this and I reproduced it by using the verbatim commands - U4 material should not change the dump output path

semantics are useful for U4: SDF geom geom_size=0.35 and mesh bounds +/-0.35 coexist, so U4 host cases can assert that SDF leaves use mesh bounds rather than geom_size; camera resolutions and light castshadow match the U3 scene
only tests/support JSON was added, no tests/*.rs changes; the U4 host case that will consume these dumps is not wired yet, so how it is used cannot be reviewed here
dumps are single-line large-array JSON (53 KB), hostile to text diff but stably parseable; sha + counts in the evidence is the right recording style

not_claimed: 不宣称渲染数值验收通过
不宣称 SDF 渲染已覆盖（dump 只是 U4 的 host 输入）
limits: dump semantics prove model data consistency only, not device rendering (U4 window)
tool identity verified against the on-disk target exe sha, not self-proven by the dump
